title: Simulation 3D Aircraft
text: Implement aircraft in 3D environment, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Color} sets Aircraft color; {Sample time}, {Type} sets the aircraft type Sky, {Path to general aviation mesh}, {Path to air transport mesh}, {Path to custom mesh}, {Name} sets the aircraft name, {Initial translation (m)} sets the initial translation of aircraft zeros, {Initial rotation (rad)} sets the aircraft rotation zeros, {Scale source}, {Initial scale} sets the initial mesh scale, {Scale} sets the mesh scale, {Enable altitude and WoW sensors} sets the altitude and WoW sensors, {Show sensor rays in viewer} sets the option to show sensor rays, {Interpret vector outputs as 1-D} controls reshaping on sensor output ports, {Length of rays (m)}, {Body Z offset (m)} sets the aircraft body Z offset, {Front tire radius (m)} sets the front gear tire radius, {Left tire radius (m)} sets the left gear tire radius, {Right tire radius (m)} sets the right gear tire radius, {WoW sensor tolerance (m)} sets the wow sensor tolerance, {Light configuration}, {Landing lights intensity (cd)}, {Landing lights cone half angle (deg)}, {Left landing light location}, {Left landing light orientation (deg)} sets the left landing light orientation, {Right landing light location}, {Right landing light orientation (deg)} sets the right landing light orientation, {Taxi lights intensity (cd)}, {Taxi lights cone half angle (deg)}, {Taxi lights location}, {Taxi lights orientation (deg)} sets the taxi lights orientation, {Navigation lights intensity}, {Position light intensity}, {Strobe lights intensity}, {Wingtip strobe period (s)}, {Wingtip strobe pulse width (% of period)}, {Tail strobe period (s)}, {Tail strobe pulse width (% of period)}, {Beacon lights intensity}, {Beacon period (s)} and {Beacon pulse width (% of period)}. Values come from the instance.
